snippet.title: Trash Day - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 Wishlist TRASH DAY on Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3314580/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=announcement&utm_content=wishlist

After working on Rocket League for nearly a decade, Off By One Games is excited to announce our first title: _TRASH DAY_

_Team up with your raccoon squad in this physics-based co-op adventure. Scavenge trash, fill your shopping cart, and work together to get back home. Live your best raccoon life._

*Dumping on Steam 2026*
———

🦝 About Trash Day
• Online 4-player co-op adventure
• Physics-driven chaos (things will go wrong)
• Steal, scrounge, and scavenge anything not nailed down
• Built for shouting at your friends

🌐 https://trashdaygame.com
🎮 https://discord.gg/rCM4PHcXCj

Follow development:
https://www.tiktok.com/@ox1games / https://twitter.com/ox1games / https://instagram.com/offbyonegames/
🦋 https://offbyonegames.bsky.social

_"Trumpet Hype” licensed via Music Vine: ZBKJII97GZGEPRS4_
